$comment: Every position in a material record and in a read request where a member the reader does not know is ignored or refused, with the sentence that decides it. `path` is a pattern of steps: a name; `a|b`, either name; `{section}` and `{field}`, the target's; `{numeric}`, `{token}` and `{condition}`, a registered condition the object holds as such, not as a status object; `{fact}`, a registered specimen fact so held; `{status}`, a member holding a status object; `[*]`, an item; `[implied_condition]`, an item that is an acceptance of that kind, and `[a|b]` one of either kind. `form`, where present, limits a position to a target field of that form. `schema` names the definitions whose members are named there: in the writer schema for a record, in `read_request.json` for a request; `$root` is the schema's own properties, `per_condition` and `per_fact` the definition the name's row takes, and `also` adds a member named at that place with the reason. `verdict`: `ignored`, an unknown member is ignored and one one slip from a named member refused; `condition_names`, a name is never ignored and never refused at step 8 (step 10 gives `unknown`); `refused`, every unknown name is refused; `not_checked`, step 8 checks nothing inside; `status`, a status object, whose tokens and the members of the shape it stands for `tests/spec_sync/status_rows.py` gives, from the text and the writer schema, for the member of the definition `schema` names (`per_condition`, `per_fact`, the definition of the condition or fact the path names). `deferred` marks a position no read of this version reaches yet, with the pieces that build it, each a piece and not a step built in pieces, which is never done: its rule is the text's, and it gets its verdict when the first of them is done. `tests/spec_sync/test_unknown_member_positions.py` checks the table against the text and the schemas, and the read against the table.
